Historical full-card image of [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|Self-Destruct Mechanism]], matching the [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
